text:
Theo (eng-sre): Quick follow-up from Ember postmortem — logging owners and micro-targets for the isolation bug. I will shepherd until Friday handoff.

Yara (eng-platform): I can take the route-tag guard and reconcile ordering fix. Hypothesis: asymmetric withdraw + stale tagged routes causing blackholes. Target: Thu EOD.

Devon (eng-runtime): I will write a rollback playbook that includes an IP-range filter and a soft-traffic-drain step. Need access to mirrored tenant for canary.

Isha (infra): I can provision mirror-ember-24h and add a synthetic probe that simulates asymmetric flows (TCP handshake + UDP health). Probe cadence 90s.

Carla (prodops): Provisioned mirror-ember-24h and granted Devon ephemeral token (48h). Drafted customer note template; scheduled Ember ops sync Wed 14:00 PDT.

Theo (eng-sre): Paste relevant snippet from control-plane logs during the outage:
[2024-08-12T21:16:03Z] BGP: withdraw 10.40.3.0/24 peer-ember-edge -> withdraw accepted but tag=old retained
[2024-08-12T21:16:04Z] Routing: route resolved -> next-hop null via stale-tag
[2024-08-12T21:16:06Z] Service: connection resets, cpu spin on route reconcile

Yara (eng-platform): Plan: when peer withdraw detected, immediately clear stale-tag entries and delay re-advertise by 12s to allow converge. Will open PR and unit tests emulating rapid withdraw/announce.

Devon (eng-runtime): Canary plan: KV priming + connectivity smoke + asymmetric-flow test. Will gate traffic shift on 3-successful probes.

Isha (infra): Probe added to staging, 90s cadence, alert on 2 consecutive failures. Question: auto-failover after 10m or pager-only?

Theo (eng-sre): Start pager-only + pre-armed failover (manual trigger). If probe fails >10m with matching BGP churn, then auto-failover to regional pool. Documented in runbook.

ops-bot: Created issue #6410 "ember-route-tag-guard" linking postmortem. Assignee: Yara. Due: 2024-09-01.

Yara (eng-platform): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1012 (WIP) — added reconcile delay and tag-clear step. Adding reviewers @Devon @Theo.

Devon (eng-runtime): Canary infra running on mirror-ember-24h: 2/2 smoke checks green, starting asymmetric-flow test.

Theo (eng-sre): Daily summary: Yara PR -> WIP; Devon canary -> running; Isha probe -> staging; Carla comms -> scheduled. Next check-in Thu 09:30 PDT. Post one-line updates as you make progress.
